source_evidence: Day328~11:06 exact player 'I want to be a partner… I can deal with the dirt' expresses interest in deeper partnership and willingness in broad terms to handle difficult matters as part of the existing commercial pretext. Not consent to specific violence, coercion, wrongdoing, expenditure, investment, access rights or partnership agreement. Harthvale responds voluntarily within the already successful Deception25/DC17&22 and his prepared commercial ambitions, distinguishing a true partner from a paid carrier. He discloses a prospective 250gp capital offer from an unnamed patron conditional on preferred exclusive supply, which he is considering rather than has accepted; this is the existing fixed prep stake in dm-ferry-setup.md @72d5bde0ab9d84d89fdc63f20cf9c7bfb63b1516, not a new fund, completed transaction or confirmation of a patron's identity. Harthvale says 'I have an offer of two hundred and fifty gold from a patron who wants an exclusive arrangement. Money is welcome. Being beholden to one household is less appealing. A partner with facilities of his own might give us a better alternative.' Broker independently says 'I prefer our customers to keep trading and the quays to stay open. Trouble is bad for both.' Harthvale responds 'Agreed. But I also expect a partner to stand by his word when business turns unpleasant.' He asks V whether he means joining as an investor with a voice in association decisions or an operating partner bringing property capacity and responsibility for difficult commercial disputes. No price, ownership fraction, trial consignment, specific threat, assignment, demanded violence, identified victim or new crime established. No new uncertain concession/check because this is voluntary exploratory response to V's stated interest following prior successful concrete proposal threshold. Mara/Cirren/Fenar hear exchange; Desen not yet informed of today's discoveries. V chooses response; no spending or change of resource or custody.
